messages:
lena_cs: AltoPayments sent a bespoke privacy/security follow-up this morning. They want KMS/HSM attestation, a 6-month audit-log export, retention policy docs, and proof of key rotation. They also reported an intermittent 401 and a latency spike in Jan. Due in 4 business days. Filing here to triage and assign owners. Ticket INC-4829. @david_sec can you own the KMS/HSM artifacts? @sam_support can you reproduce the 401? @maria_eng can you grab latency traces?


david_sec: I can take KMS/HSM. Notes: we only provide metadata and signed attestation (no plaintext keys). Will collect HSM attestation certs, key rotation records, and map to CAIQ questions. Need legal to sign final wording. Timeline: draft bundle by EOD tomorrow, final signed bundle within 48h. I'll use the runbook checklist.


sam_support: I'll start repro now. Can someone forward the customer request id or the exact curl they used that got 401? Meanwhile I'm tailing the auth logs for tenant 'alto-payments' for recent 401s.


sam_support: Quick repro steps I'm running locally:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-v2\",\"input\":\"test\"}'
# then tail logs: sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/prod-audit.log | grep alto-payments | grep 401
```


sam_support: Found pattern in logs: token_revocation events line up with customer 401s. Sample log line (sanitized):
```
2026-02-15T03:14:22Z tenant=alto-payments level=warn msg=auth_error err=token_revoked request_id=abc123
```


maria_eng: I'll pull p50/p95/p99 for the window and fetch traces. Initial observation: a latency bump on 2026-01-18 15:00 UTC that aligns with a model variant reload in region west-2. Could be cold-starts + routing fallback. Will post heatmap and trace links within 24h.


david_sec: For the audit-log export I'll run the admin export tool. Command I plan to use:
```
rbx admin export-logs --tenant alto-payments --from 2025-08-01 --to 2026-02-28 --format ndjson --include auth,kms,audit
```
This will produce NDJSON with auth and kms events (no plaintext secrets). I will also pull key rotation entries from the keystore metadata table.


audit-bot: Export job INC-4829-EXPORT has started. ETA ~20m. https://internal.redwood/jobs/INC-4829-EXPORT


sam_support: Repro notes: pattern looks like SDK token refresh race. Some SDK clients retry the request without fetching a new token after a 401, leading to back-to-back 401s. Proposed mitigation: update SDK to refresh token on first 401 and retry once. I'll open a PR and add a unit/integration test that simulates token rotation.


maria_eng: Also recommending a short ops mitigation: bump minimum replicas for west-2 during canary rollouts and pre-warm model slices to reduce cold-start p99. I'll provide a short doc with numbers and suggested config.


victor_cs: Customer specifically asked for a signed attestation (PDF), a CSV with 10 sanitized log samples, and CAIQ mapping. They also asked if we can extend the due date by 3 days if HSM vendor sign-off takes longer. I'll request the extension now.


lena_cs: Plan recap + owners:
- david_sec: KMS/HSM attestation + CAIQ mapping. Draft by EOD tomorrow, final signed within 48h.
- sam_support: 401 repro, logs, and SDK PR. 24h.
- maria_eng: latency report, p50/p95/p99 and traces. 24h.
- victor_cs: request due-date extension and handle customer comms.
I'll update customer with interim artifacts (sanitized log samples, latency summary, and mitigation steps). If extension approved we will deliver signed certs by the new date. Blockers?


david_sec: :thumbsup: starting collection. Will need legal sign-off on wording for the attestation.


sam_support: :eyes: I'll post repro steps and links to logs in INC-4829 once I have the sanitized samples.


lena_cs: Thanks all. I'll keep the customer updated and flag if we need more time. Victor — ping when you have the extension response.
